title: Los Alamos hiring during a nuclear arms race

tellings.quote: She said, "There's a huge nuclear arms race going on right now, and they're building bombs like mad."

plain: A woman connected to Los Alamos, the New Mexico weapons laboratory, said in the 2020s that the lab was hiring because "there's a huge nuclear arms race going on right now, and they're building bombs like mad." The writer Greg Bishop tells Michels this as what she told him, without naming her.
